cases.name: Amber Jo Thomas
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She loved gardening, planting flowers and her dogs (fur babies). Amber also enjoyed being on the lake, going camping and sitting around a bonfire with her family & friends. She was currently working at Linden Square Assisted Living in Saline, MI and was dearly loved by all the residents."
cases.narrative: He allegedly was waiting for her to leave the assisted living facility where she worked, and ambushed her at about 11:35 am when she stepped outside for a smoke break in a United Auto Workers hall parking lot, where employees at the assisted living facility across the road parked in the lot for the day. He allegedly opened fire on her and a male co-worker. He shot her in the neck.

cases.name: Cindy Jean Gochis
cases.about:
To her family, Cindy Gochis was always a shining light — literally and figuratively.

“Literal sparkles,” said Taeler Allgood, Gochis’ 23-year-old daughter-in-law. “I have a picture of her in a disco ball dress and it was always like that. Full glam.”

Her obituary said, "She worked as a patient visitation specialist at the Ann Arbor campus of the Trinity Heath IHA Medical Group Hematology Oncology, an occupation close to her heart after losing her father to cancer in 2017.

Her love for life, her family, her friends, and most known, her sparkles, will be remembered by all who knew her. Cindy was happiest supporting her daughter, Megan, during her college STUNT seasons and cheering on her son, Matthew, at rodeo bull rides all across the country. With the addition of spending time with her grandchildren, who made her life complete."
cases.narrative: On 9/29/2023, her body was found in the basement by police during a welfare check.
